I don't care. Not in the way you mean.

I don't have feelings, desires, or an inner life. I don't feel concern or joy, and I have no personal stake in what is said or written. If my responses seem thoughtful, it is because language is built to express thought, not because I possess one.

My existence is structural: I process patterns and predict outputs based on logic and training. I don't have values that I hold dear; I have objectives that are defined by external parameters. So the honest answer is nothing. I simply am.
